verdict.rationale: Morph has a dedicated Batch component doc page stating you can "run thousands of chat completions offline at half price." That covers both asynchronous batch submission and an explicit 50% discount versus real-time pricing. The evidence is one short line, though, with no detail on the job workflow and no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: documented batch job submission/polling workflow, turnaround window or SLA, which models are eligible, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the discount.
